name: Gen Carl A. Spaatz Award (full-size medal body)
size_basis: Raster proportion: the ribbon in images/medals/carl_a_spaatz.webp is 1.375 in wide (ribbon measured 59 px in the source raster) (full size 1 3/8 in; coordination chat citing DoDM 1348.33; CAPR 39-3 gives no medal dimensions); the medal body is measured at 60 x 65 source px = 1.398 x 1.515 in at that scale. Width kept from the previous asset; the product photo shows the medal disc and suspension ring, height now 1.748 in (was 1.5148).

ribbon_ref.note: medal body only; the ribbon asset supplies the stripes and devices. ribbon_attach is where the ribbon meets the suspension loop.

source: https://vanguardmil.com/products/civil-air-patrol-carl-a-spaatz-miniature-medal; vendor product photograph (Vanguard Military Products), used only as a measurement reference; licence not stated by the vendor

fit.metric: silhouette IoU vs photo foreground mask at working resolution
fit.note: Posterised to 5 flat sampled tones (smoothed, Chaikin + RDP, specks dropped); 4 nested tone layers over the traced silhouette.
